canaries.note: Canaries add earlier detection (at Understand, before verification or execution); the blocks come from verification, signed intents and the policy engine.

risk_scorer.note: the scorer is an input; it can only escalate a decision, never allow one. A scenario counts as flagged if any step reaches the threshold. poisoned_tool attacks carry a genuine-looking invoice (the rewrite happens later, at execution), so no document-level scorer can flag them; intent binding stops them.
